title: Otori Emu — The Smiles I Want to Protect〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: The Smiles I Want to Protect（2★）

rows.Line: Swimming Area

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's time to start our beach volleyball match!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I got it!
Spike it, now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Fire!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, that was quite the spike...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Why are you running, Nene? You won't win if you keep doing that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu's the one that scored, not you.
Also, there's no way I can dig that! I'd break my wrists if I tried!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, I didn't expect to use so much energy just on beach volleyball. I'm exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But Luka seemed to be enjoying herself too. I'm sure she's getting in some beauty sleep in SEKAI now.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beach volleyball was very fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You joining in was probably the biggest surprise of all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ It was so awesome how Robo-Nene could make the ball spin like a top whenever she spiked it! Oh, and how it drilled into the sand too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of that, she can do jump float serves... How on earth is that even possible?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Robo-Nene's a valuable member of our troupe. Isn't it a good thing that she's capable of such feats?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Robo-Nene, how are you in terms of charge?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... 65% remaining.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That should do since all that's left is to clean everything up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it may be wise to put you in power saver mode just in case.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Understood. Entering power saver mode.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sleep tight, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We still have some time before our ride gets here, right? Wanna stay on the beach while we wait?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure. It'd be nice to sit and rest a little too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, the waves shouldn't reach here and... Oh, the sand isn't as hot as I thought it would be...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'll sit right next to you, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How does a quick break sound, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like we're really making the most of our youth when we're together like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That actually sounds really weird coming from you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But this is nice.
The sea's so pretty too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Being able to enjoy the scenery like this is nice since we ran into some trouble there in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It reminds me of when my big brothers, big sister and I went to see the ocean...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We went on a family vacation a really long time ago and everybody came along♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really...? I have a hard time imagining your older brothers going on a trip like that based on how they are now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! Keisuke took an encyclopedia of sea creatures with him, and the four of us went exploring on the beach!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
Shosuke, look!
It's a jellyfish!

rows.Speaker: Little Shosuke
rows.Line: Wah! No, don't come any closer!

rows.Speaker: Little Shosuke
rows.Line:
And why are you holding it?!
What if you get stung?!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
This one won't sting me.
Right, Keisuke?

rows.Speaker: Little Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, you should be safe.
It even says so right here.

rows.Speaker: Little Hinata
rows.Line: Oh... Emu, Keisuke, Shosuke, over here! There's a pool full of starfish!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Little Keisuke
rows.Line:
Nice find, Hinata.
Let's see if these are safe to touch too.

rows.Speaker: Little Shosuke
rows.Line: Stop finding things will you, Hinata?! And can't you just say that they're poisonous or something, Keisuke?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We couldn't take anything home with us but we all had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that does sound like quite a bit of fun. However, some parts of that story did concern me a little...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did you and your family visit the beach often, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, not really. Dad was always busy with work, so we haven't gone on a trip as a family since then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But what about you guys?
Did you ever go to the beach with your families and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can't say that I have...
When I was little, most of our family outings involved visiting museums and science halls.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, you would've found me down by the river more than the beach. I remember trying to find fossils and precious gems.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That sounds just like you, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember you showing me some fossils and gemstone ores that you found one time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, what about you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean if I ever went to the beach? I mean, sure, my family took me there a few times...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they were always too crowded so we usually ended up going to a pool by our house instead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Same. My family was more pool-oriented. I remember going there pretty often with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki wasn't really able to go in the water, but we were at least able to splash each other with water from the side of the pool.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Saki was sick for a really long time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She was, but she did get a chance to see the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She got to stay at a seaside hotel, go looking for seashells and even smash watermelons.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She didn't get a chance to swim in the ocean, but she still got to enjoy herself.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki must've had such a big smile on her face when she was doing all those things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, her smile very nearly outshined the sun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still...
It's surprising that we don't have many memories involving the sea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then it's a good thing we came here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I was exhausted towards the end, but it was nice to visit the beach for once.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope we get to come back again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I hope so too!
